# Featurebase — Style Reference

> Unbleached paper help desk with one cobalt pebble. Geist at weight 400 sets the headlines in ink and ash, hairline rings draw every panel, and a cobalt agent glows only inside the screenshots.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Featurebase speaks a warm-ink product language: a #ffffff canvas (159 background uses) layered with warm stone panels at #f4f4f2 (75 uses), pebble pill fills at #ebebe8, and near-black #0d0d0d ink that carries 166 text uses and every primary CTA. The chromatic budget is one hue family. Cobalt #4a52d8 and signal blue #3b5bff are rationed to the product itself: the Fibi agent orb, chart highlights, selection rings and the frosted gradient wash behind mockups. The marketing chrome never receives them. Typography is the thesis. Geist at weight 400, 56px, tracked to -2.24px (-0.04em), sets two-tone headlines with an ink first line and an ash #8e8e8a second line. Hierarchy comes from tone rather than weight, and the size jump from 19px straight to 56px skips every conventional modular step. Shapes are pills (9999px) for anything clickable and 18–22px rounds for panels. Elevation is a hairline ring plus a whisper shadow at 0.03–0.05 alpha. The page reads as a gallery frame for software rather than a billboard for a brand.

## Tokens — Colors

|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page canvas, mockup panels, status pills and the hero product frame (159 background uses). It is the neutral stage that lets screenshots read as the content. |
| Stone Wash | `#f4f4f2` | `--color-stone-wash` | Feature side cards, avatar wells, icon tiles and mockup sidebars (75 uses). This warm secondary surface separates regions without a border. |
| Frosted Wash | `#eceff6` | `--color-frosted-wash` | The cool backdrop behind product mockups and the base of the hero gradient (10 uses). It is the only cool neutral, and it signals "inside the product". Do not use it for marketing cards. |
| Dove Pill | `#efefec` | `--color-dove-pill` | Fill of the "Meet Fibi AI" secondary pill in section heroes. It sits one shade lighter than Pebble Fill, so the companion action recedes. |
| Pebble Fill | `#ebebe8` | `--color-pebble-fill` | Fill of the "Log in" and "Get a demo" secondary pills. It is the workhorse quiet-action color, and it reads as a pressed stone beside the ink CTA. |
| Ink | `#0d0d0d` | `--color-ink` | Headline first lines, nav labels, primary CTA fills and app-icon tiles (166 text and 38 background uses). Near-black rather than pure black keeps the warm temperature. |
| Charcoal Heading | `#2b2b29` | `--color-charcoal-heading` | Names, detail headings and table values inside product mockups (46 uses). This softened ink keeps dense UI from shouting. |
| Slate Ink | `#2b3040` | `--color-slate-ink` | Text inside cool-toned mockup regions such as charts and reports (46 uses). It is mockup-internal in spirit. Do not use it for marketing copy. |

| Fog Border | `#e9e9e6` | `--color-fog-border` | Mockup panel outlines, status-pill borders and dividers (40 combined uses, with #e6e6e3 snapped in). This warm hairline is the system's only line. |
| Cobalt Agent | `#4a52d8` | `--color-cobalt-agent` | The Fibi mascot orb, highlighted chart bars and agent bullets (20 uses). It is the product's identity color, permitted only inside product representations. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Signal Blue | `#3b5bff` | `--color-signal-blue` | 1.5px inset selection rings, active chart series and gradient highlights (10 background uses, 7 ring uses). It is state punctuation rather than decoration. Never use it on a marketing button. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Geist — display headlines and all marketing UI, quiet at every size · `--font-geist`

- **Substitute:** Geist at 400 (the original is open-source, use it if possible), Inter Display at 400, Onest at 400. Geist draws slightly light and narrow at display sizes, so avoid Manrope, which renders visibly heavier at the same number.
- **Weights:** 400, 450, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 14px, 15px, 19px, 56px
- **Line height:** 1.02 (56px), 1.25 (19px medium), 1.5 (19px regular), 1.55 (14–15px)
- **Letter spacing:** -2.24px at 56px, -0.285px at 19px medium, -0.075px at 15px medium, -0.07px at 14px medium, 0px at 14–15px regular
- **OpenType features:** `calt`, `rlig`
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 56px is the signature. Headlines are large and quiet, and they get their authority from -0.04em tracking and a 1.02 line height rather than from bold strokes. The scale is anti-convention. It runs 14 → 15 → 19, then leaps to 56 (a 2.95× jump), where a Perfect Fourth would place 25, 33 and 44px in between. The result separates headlines from everything else with one cliff instead of a staircase. Weight 500 is reserved for interactive labels (nav, buttons), so in Geist, medium means clickable.

### Inter — the voice of the product mockups, dense and literal · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 with the same character variants enabled, SF Pro Text at 400, Roboto Flex at 400 (Roboto Flex draws marginally wider, so keep its width axis at 98 or below).
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 10.5px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 17px
- **Line height:** 1.333 (12px), 1.5 (10.5px and 13px), 1.43 (14px)
- **Letter spacing:** -0.12px at 12px medium, 0px elsewhere
- **OpenType features:** `calt`, `rlig`, `cv02`, `cv03`, `cv04`, `cv11`
- **Role:** Inter is used 557 times, almost entirely inside fake product UI (inboxes, ticket details, chart legends), which gives the screenshots their own typographic dialect. The cv02/cv03/cv04/cv11 variants switch on open digits and a single-story a, a deliberate app-UI fingerprint. The pairing works as a frame-and-picture split: Geist speaks for the company, Inter speaks for the software.

### Geist Mono — uppercase eyebrows and section links, the technical micro-label · `--font-geist-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400, JetBrains Mono at 300 (JetBrains draws heavier than its number, so drop one step).
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px
- **Line height:** 1.333
- **Letter spacing:** 0.72px at 12px (estimated, uppercase)
- **Role:** Geist Mono labels such as "HELP DESK" and "EXPLORE HELP DESK →" appear only 18 times, but they set the cadence of every section. Uppercase plus positive tracking is the only place letters spread apart, which makes these labels read as filing tabs rather than headlines. The mono texture nods to a developer audience without adopting a terminal aesthetic.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 500 | 10.5px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Geist Mono | 400 | 12px | 1.333 | 0.72px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 13px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Geist | — | 14px | 1.55 | -0.07px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Geist | — | 15px | 1.55 | -0.075px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Geist | 400 | 19px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Geist | 500 | 19px | 1.25 | -0.285px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Geist | 400 | 36px | 1.1 | -1.44px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Geist | 400 | 56px | 1.02 | -2.24px | `--text-display` |

The `heading` row is the estimated mobile display step. It keeps the -0.04em tracking ratio of `display`.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Geist 400 at 56px with -2.24px tracking and a 1.02 line height. Quiet weight at large size is the brand's voice.
- Split headlines into an Ink #0d0d0d line and an Ash #8e8e8a line. The tonal drop carries hierarchy without a subheading element.
- Make the primary CTA an Ink #0d0d0d pill, 44px tall, 9999px radius, 0px 22px padding. Value contrast locates the action on a colorless frame.
- Pair every ink pill with a Pebble #ebebe8 pill of identical size. Equal mass makes the choice feel calm rather than ranked.
- Confine Cobalt #4a52d8 and Signal Blue #3b5bff to mockups, charts, the Fibi orb and 1.5px selection rings. Color is the product's property, not the page's.
- Nest content as a #f4f4f2 tray (18px radius, 20px padding) holding a #ffffff tile (12px radius). Tonal layering replaces drop shadows on content cards.
- Leave 168px between sections inside a 1264px container. The generous rhythm lets each screenshot read as a separate exhibit.

### Don't

- Don't bold the headlines to weight 600 or 700. A heavy 56px headline turns the restrained two-tone voice into a generic SaaS shout and breaks the thesis that tone, not weight, ranks text.
- Don't fill the primary button with #3b5bff because the product is blue. That spends the single chromatic budget on chrome, and the mockups stop being the only colored thing on the page.
- Don't swap the warm grays for cool ones such as #e3e6ed (mockup-internal, not a system token) on marketing surfaces. The warm #f4f4f2/#e9e9e6 temperature separates frame from product.
- Don't add 0.15-alpha drop shadows to cards. The system's heaviest content shadow is 0.03 alpha, and anything darker reads as stock UI kit rather than paper.
- Don't round buttons to 8px or 12px in marketing sections. The 9999px pill is non-negotiable for site-level actions, and 6px belongs only to imitation in-app controls.
- Don't insert 28px, 36px or 44px intermediate headings on desktop. The scale deliberately jumps from 19px to 56px, and filler sizes dissolve that cliff.
- Never use the decorative mockup hues #e79a86 or #5fb7a6 (decorative, not system tokens) for status or links outside screenshots. They are avatar and chart dressing only.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f4f4f2 (Stone Wash)
- primary text: #0d0d0d (Ink)
- secondary text: #5b5b58 (Graphite Caption)
- headline second line: #8e8e8a (Ash Muted)
- hairline: #e9e9e6 (Fog Border)
- product accent: #4a52d8 (Cobalt Agent)
- primary action: #0d0d0d (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use neutral bars in #0d0d0d, #8e8e8a and #ebebe8, and at most one highlighted series in solid #4a52d8 or #3b5bff, so the accent marks the insight rather than decorating every bar.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #0d0d0d, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 0px 22px, height 44px, display inline-flex, align-items center. Use Geist at 15px, weight 500, line height 1.55 and letter-spacing -0.075px, with no shadow. Place a secondary twin beside it with 8px gap: background #ebebe8, text #0d0d0d, identical radius, padding and type. On hover, darken the secondary fill to #e9e9e6 and lift the primary with box-shadow rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px 0px.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff: a centered column with max-width 880px and 168px top padding below a 68px fixed nav. Set the headline in Geist 400, 56px, line height 1.02, letter-spacing -2.24px, color #0d0d0d. Below it at 20px, add a subtitle in Geist 400, 19px, line height 1.5, color #5b5b58, max-width 640px. Then at 32px add the Ink and Pebble pill pair (44px tall, 9999px radius, 0px 22px padding). At 64px below, place a 1040×600px product frame with background #ffffff, border-radius 22px and box-shadow rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(20, 24, 60, 0.18) 0px 24px 60px -32px. Set it over a full-width #eceff6 backdrop that fades to #ffffff at the top.

3. Build a feature card: a container with background #f4f4f2, border-radius 18px, padding 20px and no border or shadow. Inside, place a white tile with background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, padding 16px and box-shadow rgba(17, 17, 19, 0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 0px 1px 1.5px 0px inset. Fill the tile with a two-column key/value list in Inter 13px at 400, keys in #8e8e8a and values in #2b2b29, 12px row gap. Below the tile, 16px down, add a title in Geist 15px at 400 color #0d0d0d, then a 4px gap, then a description in Geist 14px at 400 color #5b5b58 with line height 1.55.

4. Build a navigation bar: position fixed, height 68px, background #ffffff, inner max-width 1264px, flex with space-between. Left: a 22px logo mark plus "Featurebase" in Geist 15px at 400 #0d0d0d. Then links rendered as 34px pills with radius 999px, padding 0px 12px, Geist 14px at 500, letter-spacing -0.07px, color #0d0d0d, transparent fill and hover fill #f4f4f2, with 4px gap. Right: a "Log in" pill (background #ebebe8, 36px tall, padding 0px 16px, radius 9999px) and a "Start for free" pill (background #0d0d0d, text #ffffff, same size), with 8px gap.

| lg | `rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(20, 24, 60, 0.18) 0px 24px 60px -32px` | `--shadow-lg` |

### Layout

- **Page max-width:** 1264px (880–1280px)
- **Section gap:** 168px (56–168px)
- **Card padding:** 20px (12–24px)
- **Element gap:** 12px (4–16px)

## Components

### Pill Button — Ink (Primary)

**Role:** The single conversion action per view

Black, round, unadorned. The hero-size spec is a #0d0d0d background with #ffffff text, no border, a 9999px radius, 0px 22px padding, a 44px height, Geist 15px at weight 500 with -0.075px tracking, and no shadow. The nav variant drops to a 36px height, 0px 16px padding and Geist 14px at 500. Ink fill on a white canvas is the only high-contrast surface in the marketing chrome, so the CTA is located by value contrast rather than hue. This is deliberately anti-convention for a SaaS site with a blue product.

### Pill Button — Pebble (Secondary)

**Role:** Companion action beside the ink pill

A quiet stone twin. The spec is a #ebebe8 background with #0d0d0d text, no border, a 9999px radius, 0px 22px padding, a 44px height, Geist 15px at weight 500 with -0.075px tracking, and no shadow. The "Meet Fibi AI" variant lightens the fill to #efefec, and the nav "Log in" variant runs at 36px with 0px 16px padding. Using fill rather than an outline keeps the pair the same visual mass, so the secondary reads as an alternative rather than a downgrade.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Fixed top bar, links as pills

Fixed and flat. The spec is a 68px fixed bar on #ffffff with no bottom border. The logo mark and "Featurebase" wordmark sit left in Geist 15px at 400 #0d0d0d (10px logo radius). Product, Solutions and Resources are 34px dropdown pills with a 999px radius, 0px 10px 0px 12px padding and Geist 14px at 500 with -0.07px tracking. Customers and Pricing follow as 34px pills, then "Log in" (Pebble) and "Start for free" (Ink) sit right at 36px. Links are invisible pills until hovered, so the bar behaves like a toolbar rather than a menu.

### Hero Product Frame

**Role:** The page's centerpiece screenshot

A floating application window. The spec is a 1040×600px #ffffff container with a 22px radius, no padding and no CSS border. It uses the lg shadow stack: a 1px ink ring at 0.06 alpha, a 1px contact shadow at 0.04, and a long 24px 60px -32px drop tinted rgba(20, 24, 60, 0.18). That last value is the system outlier, the only blue-tinted shadow, permitted because it sits over the Frosted Wash #eceff6 gradient. Its 22px radius breaks the 18px card rule on purpose, so the frame reads as hardware glass rather than a card.

### Product Mockup Panel

**Role:** Inbox, conversation and detail columns

Columns of real software. Each panel has a #ffffff background with #5b5b58 default text, a 1px solid #e9e9e6 border, a 20px radius and no padding. It uses the md shadow, two layered 0.03-alpha drops at 10px 15px -3px and 4px 6px -4px. Content inside is Inter 13px at 400 for messages and Inter 14px at 500 for names in #0d0d0d. Three panels sit side by side with 6px gaps. The panels deliberately follow a different typeface from the frame around them, so visitors read them as product rather than layout.

### Feature Card — Stone

**Role:** Side card holding a product fact

A stone tray holding a white tile. The spec is a #f4f4f2 background, no border, an 18px radius and 20px padding. The inner tile is #ffffff with a 12px radius and the subtle-2 inset ring (a 1px rgba(17, 17, 19, 0.07) inner line with a 0.3-alpha top highlight). The card title "Full customer context" is Geist 15px at 400 #0d0d0d over a Graphite #5b5b58 14px description. Tray-and-tile nesting replaces shadows entirely, which makes this the workhorse content card.

### Floating Product Banner

**Role:** Caption pinned under hero mockup

A caption bar posing as a notification. The spec is a #ffffff background, a 14px radius, 12px 16px padding and the sm shadow. A 28px Stone Wash icon tile with a 10px radius sits left. Copy is "Help Desk" in Geist 14px at 500 #0d0d0d over Graphite 13px. An Ink "Learn more" button with a 6px radius and 8px 10px padding sits right. The 6px button radius breaks the pill rule, which is allowed because it imitates an in-app control rather than a marketing CTA.

### Two-Tone Section Headline

**Role:** Every section's opening statement

Two tones, one weight. The spec is Geist 56px at 400, line height 1.02 and -2.24px tracking. Line one is Ink #0d0d0d and line two is Ash #8e8e8a ("The complete help desk / for your team and AI"). There is no background, no border and a max width of 880px. Inline product chips (a Stone Wash 10px-radius tile holding app icons) can sit inside the line at cap height. The tonal step replaces a separate subhead, so one element carries both claim and qualification.

### Mono Eyebrow Label

**Role:** Section tab above headlines

A filing tab. The spec is Geist Mono 12px at 400, uppercase, 0.72px tracking (estimated) and #5b5b58, preceded by a 12px glyph icon with an 8px gap. There is no background, border or radius. The right-aligned variant "EXPLORE HELP DESK →" uses the same spec with an arrow and acts as a section-level link. Mono plus tracking is the only letter-spaced-open text on the page, which gives it the authority of a label rather than a sentence.

### Feature Tab List

**Role:** Three-column switcher beneath mockups

A tab strip without tabs. Each column has a 16px glyph icon, a title in Geist 15px at 400 (active in #0d0d0d, inactive in #8e8e8a), a two-line Geist 14px description in #5b5b58 (fading to #8e8e8a when inactive) and a Geist Mono 12px uppercase link with an arrow. There are no borders, fills or radius. The columns are 264px wide with 48px gutters. Active state is communicated by tone alone, the same mechanism as the two-tone headline.

### Status Pill Badge

**Role:** Inbox filters and conversation states

Small, white and lifted. The spec is a #ffffff background with #5b5b58 text (snapped from the measured #5c5c58), a 1px solid #e9e9e6 border, a 9999px radius, 6px 10px padding, a 26px height, Inter 12px at weight 500 and the subtle shadow at rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px. It inherits the pill vocabulary of the marketing buttons but speaks in Inter. This is the hinge where product chrome and site chrome share one shape.

### Customer Logo Row

**Role:** Social proof in two rows

A gray wall with brand accents. Two rows of six logos sit centered in the 1264px container with 56px between rows. Most marks render in their own monochrome or muted brand colors at roughly 22px cap height, and "See customers →" closes the second row in Geist 14px at 400 #5b5b58. There is no card, border or background. Logo colors are third-party and not system tokens. The row sits on Paper Canvas so customer brands, not Featurebase, supply the only stray color in the marketing frame.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Geist 400 at 56px with -2.24px tracking and a 1.02 line height. Quiet weight at large size is the brand's voice.
- Split headlines into an Ink #0d0d0d line and an Ash #8e8e8a line. The tonal drop carries hierarchy without a subheading element.
- Make the primary CTA an Ink #0d0d0d pill, 44px tall, 9999px radius, 0px 22px padding. Value contrast locates the action on a colorless frame.
- Pair every ink pill with a Pebble #ebebe8 pill of identical size. Equal mass makes the choice feel calm rather than ranked.
- Confine Cobalt #4a52d8 and Signal Blue #3b5bff to mockups, charts, the Fibi orb and 1.5px selection rings. Color is the product's property, not the page's.
- Nest content as a #f4f4f2 tray (18px radius, 20px padding) holding a #ffffff tile (12px radius). Tonal layering replaces drop shadows on content cards.
- Leave 168px between sections inside a 1264px container. The generous rhythm lets each screenshot read as a separate exhibit.

### Don't

- Don't bold the headlines to weight 600 or 700. A heavy 56px headline turns the restrained two-tone voice into a generic SaaS shout and breaks the thesis that tone, not weight, ranks text.
- Don't fill the primary button with #3b5bff because the product is blue. That spends the single chromatic budget on chrome, and the mockups stop being the only colored thing on the page.
- Don't swap the warm grays for cool ones such as #e3e6ed (mockup-internal, not a system token) on marketing surfaces. The warm #f4f4f2/#e9e9e6 temperature separates frame from product.
- Don't add 0.15-alpha drop shadows to cards. The system's heaviest content shadow is 0.03 alpha, and anything darker reads as stock UI kit rather than paper.
- Don't round buttons to 8px or 12px in marketing sections. The 9999px pill is non-negotiable for site-level actions, and 6px belongs only to imitation in-app controls.
- Don't insert 28px, 36px or 44px intermediate headings on desktop. The scale deliberately jumps from 19px to 56px, and filler sizes dissolve that cliff.
- Never use the decorative mockup hues #e79a86 or #5fb7a6 (decorative, not system tokens) for status or links outside screenshots. They are avatar and chart dressing only.

The rule is a hairline ring plus a whisper shadow. Every content shadow stays at or below 0.05 alpha, and only the hero frame earns a long 60px blur.

## Imagery

There is no photography. Imagery is product screenshots rebuilt in live HTML: inbox columns, ticket details, a conversation-volume bar chart, a workflow chain and a Fibi chat transcript. Each is framed in #ffffff panels with 20–22px radii, 1px #e9e9e6 hairlines and 0.03-alpha shadows. Mockups sit on Frosted Wash #eceff6 tiles washed with a soft blue gradient and a fine dot grid, decorative rather than tokenized. That cool glow is the only gradient on the page, and it always sits behind product rather than behind copy. Icons are small solid glyphs in #0d0d0d or #5b5b58 at 12–16px with no outline style. The Fibi mascot, a Cobalt #4a52d8 orb with two white eyes, is the single illustrated character. The narrative: the software is the art, and the site is the gallery wall.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1264px container, narrowing to 880px for headline columns and 640px for the hero subtitle. Sections are separated by 168px, and the hero stacks a centered 56px headline, a 19px Graphite subtitle, a centered Ink and Pebble pill pair, then the 1040px product frame on a frosted gradient with a floating caption banner. Sections alternate between a left-aligned headline with a mockup grid (one 555px mockup plus a 230px Stone Wash side column) and centered statement headlines. Feature switchers use three columns, logos sit six per row in two rows, and Fibi features use a two-column mockup-plus-list split. The nav is fixed, 68px tall and filled #ffffff, with the logo left and pill links plus Log in and Start for free right. The footer is a 438px block with 56px vertical padding. On a 375px phone, use the 36px heading step for display text and 64px section gaps. Overall density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f4f4f2 (Stone Wash)
- primary text: #0d0d0d (Ink)
- secondary text: #5b5b58 (Graphite Caption)
- headline second line: #8e8e8a (Ash Muted)
- hairline: #e9e9e6 (Fog Border)
- product accent: #4a52d8 (Cobalt Agent)
- primary action: #0d0d0d (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use neutral bars in #0d0d0d, #8e8e8a and #ebebe8, and at most one highlighted series in solid #4a52d8 or #3b5bff, so the accent marks the insight rather than decorating every bar.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #0d0d0d, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 0px 22px, height 44px, display inline-flex, align-items center. Use Geist at 15px, weight 500, line height 1.55 and letter-spacing -0.075px, with no shadow. Place a secondary twin beside it with 8px gap: background #ebebe8, text #0d0d0d, identical radius, padding and type. On hover, darken the secondary fill to #e9e9e6 and lift the primary with box-shadow rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px 0px.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff: a centered column with max-width 880px and 168px top padding below a 68px fixed nav. Set the headline in Geist 400, 56px, line height 1.02, letter-spacing -2.24px, color #0d0d0d. Below it at 20px, add a subtitle in Geist 400, 19px, line height 1.5, color #5b5b58, max-width 640px. Then at 32px add the Ink and Pebble pill pair (44px tall, 9999px radius, 0px 22px padding). At 64px below, place a 1040×600px product frame with background #ffffff, border-radius 22px and box-shadow rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(20, 24, 60, 0.18) 0px 24px 60px -32px. Set it over a full-width #eceff6 backdrop that fades to #ffffff at the top.

3. Build a feature card: a container with background #f4f4f2, border-radius 18px, padding 20px and no border or shadow. Inside, place a white tile with background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, padding 16px and box-shadow rgba(17, 17, 19, 0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 0px 1px 1.5px 0px inset. Fill the tile with a two-column key/value list in Inter 13px at 400, keys in #8e8e8a and values in #2b2b29, 12px row gap. Below the tile, 16px down, add a title in Geist 15px at 400 color #0d0d0d, then a 4px gap, then a description in Geist 14px at 400 color #5b5b58 with line height 1.55.

4. Build a navigation bar: position fixed, height 68px, background #ffffff, inner max-width 1264px, flex with space-between. Left: a 22px logo mark plus "Featurebase" in Geist 15px at 400 #0d0d0d. Then links rendered as 34px pills with radius 999px, padding 0px 12px, Geist 14px at 500, letter-spacing -0.07px, color #0d0d0d, transparent fill and hover fill #f4f4f2, with 4px gap. Right: a "Log in" pill (background #ebebe8, 36px tall, padding 0px 16px, radius 9999px) and a "Start for free" pill (background #0d0d0d, text #ffffff, same size), with 8px gap.

## Two-Tone Headlines

The discipline is that hierarchy lives in tone, never in weight. Every 56px headline is Geist 400 with an Ink #0d0d0d clause followed by an Ash #8e8e8a clause, and the feature tabs repeat the move: active titles in ink, inactive in ash. Three mistakes would break it: raising the headline to weight 600, adding a separate 24px subheading under it, or dropping the second line to a third gray. Each one introduces a second hierarchy mechanism and the restraint collapses. To extend the system, keep exactly two tones per headline, let the ash line carry the qualifier ("for your team and AI"), and embed product chips inline at cap height on a #f4f4f2 tile with a 10px radius rather than adding icons above the text.

## Rationed Cobalt

The chromatic budget is one hue family, and it belongs to the product. Cobalt #4a52d8 appears 20 times and Signal Blue #3b5bff 10 times as backgrounds, plus 7 inset rings, and every instance sits inside a mockup, a chart, the Fibi orb or the frosted backdrop. The marketing chrome is ink, stone and pebble. The system breaks the moment blue reaches a nav link, an eyebrow label or the "Start for free" pill, because the screenshots then lose their status as the only colored objects on the page. To extend it, add new product illustrations freely in cobalt, but keep any new marketing component inside the #0d0d0d to #f4f4f2 range and signal state with tone or a 1px #e9e9e6 hairline.

## Similar Brands

- **Linear** — The same ink-on-light marketing frame where product screenshots supply nearly all the color, though Linear runs a dark canvas where Featurebase stays warm white.
- **Vercel** — Shares the Geist and Geist Mono family, near-black pill CTAs and uppercase mono eyebrows, but Vercel's grays are cool and neutral rather than warm stone.
- **Intercom** — A direct category competitor with an AI agent mascot and inbox mockups, but Intercom spends its accent on CTAs where Featurebase keeps them black.
- **Attio** — The same warm off-white surfaces and 0.03-alpha whisper shadows around rebuilt-in-HTML product UI, with a similarly restrained one-accent budget.
- **Plain** — A support-tool peer with the same monochrome pill buttons and gallery-style screenshot framing, slightly more editorial in its type sizes.
